story: Create your own game engine but don't use it (2017)
text: Mike Acton has some pretty common sense views on this: [VIDEO] Basically if your making your own game engine then use the context in which you are working. If you are going to end up with something generic like Unity maybe you should just use something like Unity from the start.

story: Ask HN: Is it a waste of time to teach yourself data science without a degree?
text: As Mike Acton (Data Oriented Design Guru) once said in an interview "I don't care what you learned in school.. I care about what you learned of your own volition" [paraphrased from 1]. It never hurts to learn new things. Another HN poster suggested this channel for beefing up on linear algebra, and I absolutely love it [2]. [1] [VIDEO] [2] [LINK]

You could spend 2 minutes looking up who you are talking about. This video from 2015 where Casey is interviewing Mike Acton: [VIDEO] Also this course where he specifically talks about Numpy and pure Python: [LINK]
